title: Northbeam TechWorks Business Account Note: Labour Carried on an Invoice
content:
Which labour on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job a business invoice settlement covers turns on whether the job stands completed and on the days its labour is billed for.

**Where the job stands completed and labour stands billed on it both for the day it was completed and for earlier days**, every labour charge standing on the job is covered.

**Where the job stands completed and labour stands billed on it only for the day it was completed**, the labour billed for that day is covered.

**Where neither situation holds**, the labour the settlement covers is the labour billed on the day the invoice is settled.

## The readings side by side

| The job | Labour billed on it | The labour covered |
| --- | --- | --- |
| stands completed | for the day it was completed and for earlier days too | every labour charge standing on the job |
| stands completed | for the day it was completed only | the labour billed for the day it was completed |
| stands in any other state | any | the labour billed on the day the invoice is settled |

The first two readings turn on the job standing completed: where it stands booked, dispatched, held for parts, called off or recorded as a failed attendance, the third reading governs whatever days its labour is billed for.

The second reading is read from the count of labour entries: where every labour entry standing on the job is booked for the day it was completed, no earlier day carries labour and that day's labour is what is covered.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

**A completed job with labour on two days.** The job stands completed, with 180.00 USD billed for an earlier attendance and 297.50 USD for the day it was completed. Every labour charge standing on the job is covered: 477.50 USD.

**A completed job with labour on the completion day only.** The job stands completed and its single labour entry of 297.50 USD is booked for that day. 297.50 USD is covered.

**A job still held for parts.** The job does not stand completed, so the labour covered is the labour billed on the day the invoice is settled, whatever labour stands on it for earlier days.
